**Ally: Space Limitations** is an ally quest for Sofia Daguerre in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

Go to the indicated location and retrieve the weapon case; the quest marker will appear when the player character is near the weapon case. Return it to Sofia to complete the quest.
